name: Video Games
overview: Scripture calls believers to carefully guard their eyes and hearts from wickedness and vanity, emphasizing the importance of setting no evil before the eyes and turning away from worthless things. It teaches the value of numbering our days wisely to apply our hearts to godly wisdom and to enjoy the good gifts God provides without becoming attached to earthly treasures that are temporary and corruptible. In light of these principles, engaging with video games should be approached with discernment, ensuring they do not promote violence or lead the soul away from the way of the Lord.
